name: 0-auf-extend-guard
title: AUF Extend Guard
author: AdminUnknownFixes
description: Companion to AdminUnknownFixes. Factorio reads the numbered entries of the list handed to data:extend and ignores anything else, so a mod that leaves a stray field there is quietly forgiven. PyPostProcessing replaces data:extend with one that walks every key, and reads that stray field as a prototype, which is what stops the load in bobpower 3.0.0. This mod hands the walker only the entries the game itself would have used. The name begins with a zero on purpose: this has to be in place before the mod that trips over it, and AdminUnknownFixes loads too late to do it.
